newsitem.title: CHINA: China launches interbank treasury bill market.
newsitem.headline: China launches interbank treasury bill market.

text.p: China's central bank, the People's Bank of China, ordered all commercial banks to begin trading of treasury bills on Monday only through an interbank trading system.

The circular issued by the central bank, and published in the Financial News, ordered all banks to halt spot and repurchase trading on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges as well as in local security trading centres.
The notice applies only to banks.
The China local currency interbank market will launch spot and repurchase trading after the banks were ordered to halt trading on the Shenzhen and Shanghai exchanges from June 6, the notice said.

"The spirit of the notice is part of central bank's measures to ensure the healthy development of the money markets and at the same time to block large amounts of bank capital from flowing into stock markets," the notice said.
"Since last year, some bank funds have flowed into the stock markets through treasury repurchase trading on stock exchanges," it said.
"(This) spurred speculative activity on the markets, increased the capital operation risk of banks, disrupted normal financial order and even led to cases of economic crime," it said.
"Because of this, trading of commercial banks in treasury bills has been stopped on stock exchanges," it said.
Spot trading in treasury bonds will include all types of tradeable bonds and bonds for repurchase trading will include state debt, financial bonds and central bank finance bills, the notice said.
Only banks that are members of the local currency interbank market will be allowed to conduct trading, including 16 commercial banks and 11 urban cooperative banks, it said.
Non-banking financial institutions and non-financial institutions will not be allowed to participate in the interbank market, it said.
Clearing will be carried out through the China Government Securities Depository Trust and Clearing Co, it said.
Trading will be through price negotiation on a deal by deal basis, it said, adding that the central bank would not set restrictions on trading prices or on interest rates on repurchase agreements.
The maximum period for repurchase is four months, it said.
Short selling by the banks is banned, it said.
